params.val: single-target moves from the opposing side are redirected to the user this turn
the incoming move targets the whole field/side rather than a single Pokémon, or is flagged to ignore redirection

verified via Showdown source (moves.ts followme/ragepowder): the two setters are NOT fully equivalent — Rage Powder additionally checks the attacker's powder immunity (source.runStatusImmunity('powder')) and does NOT redirect attacks from Grass-type Pokémon or anything else immune to powder moves (Overcoat, Safety Goggles); Follow Me has no such check and redirects regardless of the attacker's type/ability/item. This entry covers both setters generically — the powder-immunity carve-out is Rage Powder-only.
